in_english.name: Hunaydah
in_english.meaning: Hunaydah refers to the wives of the Prophet Muhammad
in_english.long_meaning: Hunaydah refers to the wives of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), who were from the tribe of Quraysh. All of them were free, independent women who were beloved by the Prophet (peace be upon him). Allah was pleased with all of them. They were all righteous, virtuous women who were devoted to Islam. They were all part of the Prophet's household, and each one had a unique role to play in the early Islamic community. Their names are a testament to the importance of women in Islamic society and the value placed on their virtues and contributions.
